title: Geodesically Complete Curvature-Bounce Inflation
summary: The early universe need not be described by an incomplete inflationary phase connected to a separate, more exotic prehistory. Recent results show that, within non-static FRW cosmology, only positive spatial curvature permits a nonsingular, geodesically complete universe with ANEC-respecting matter. We construct a geodesically complete closed $k=+1$ bounce-plus-inflation cosmology in ordinary general relativity, sourced by a single canonical scalar field with a positive vacuum offset.
